prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: wide editorial illustration for the Zombie Wall app card on adivio.cloud, a pale cream and sage green app-directory website whose other cards use refined naturally lit photography.
Primary request: Create one beautiful wide cinematic scene that communicates defending a wall against zombies while visually fitting an elegant, warm, understated website. This is atmospheric promotional art, not a screenshot and not a product mockup.
Scene: a substantial weathered concrete defensive wall seen at a three-quarter angle, a large industrial searchlight on its parapet casting a clearly visible warm golden beam into soft pale sage-grey fog. A distant small group of shambling zombie silhouettes emerges through the mist beyond the wall; readable as a horde but understated, no close-up monsters. A few quiet fortified city roof shapes are suggested behind the wall.
Style: sophisticated photoreal cinematic environment illustration, believable concrete and metal texture, restrained visual detail, soft natural early morning light, editorial photography quality. Inviting visual clarity, dramatic but not horror-poster treatment. Warm cream highlights, muted olive and sage mist, deep desaturated teal shadows and amber searchlight, harmonizing with light oak and cream lifestyle photography elsewhere on the site.
Composition: landscape 1536x1024, full bleed edge to edge. Main searchlight and recognizable stretch of wall grouped around the center, fog and environment extend to both edges. Keep all essential content inside the central 55 percent of image height so a wide 2.3:1 center crop works. Good readable silhouette at thumbnail scale, balanced depth, no huge blank zones. No framing, borders, rounded corners, icon tile or empty padding.
Text: none.
Avoid: text, lettering, logos, UI, phones, screens, watermarks, gore, exposed organs, blood, neon colors, explosions, clutter, cartoon toy miniatures, tabletop scenes, excessive darkness. Output only the final image.
description_cs: Ilustrační scéna Zombie Wall pro web Adivio, nikoli snímek herního rozhraní.
